summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc, a foreign private issuer, disclosing periodic notifications under the UK FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. The filing includes two sections: a sale of 3,175 ordinary shares by a PDMR (Chief Commercial Officer) at $94.70/share on May 1, 2026, and acquisitions of fractional shares under the UK Share Plan by the CFO and General Counsel on May 19, 2026. These are standard insider transaction reports with no special-situation elements. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or corporate event is described; the filing merely meets ongoing reporting obligations.
